run_infer_narrator_submitit_job: run a multinode submitit job to infer narrator captions using main_infer_narrator
run_parse_args: run parse_args to get CLI arguments for gpus, nodes, timeout, partition, and job_dir
run_get_shared_folder: run get_shared_folder to get the shared checkpoint path for experiment outputs
run_get_init_file: run get_init_file to create a unique init file URI for distributed training
run_trainer_call: run the Trainer class to setup GPU args and call main_infer_narrator.main with submitit
